tools.name: import_order_changes
tools.description: What changed in Japan's MHLW imported food inspection order documents since a date? From this service's own record of the PDF versions it downloaded (MHLW replaces the attachments without publishing an amendment history): rows added, removed or modified (before and after as published) and documents

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
